4613-4644-6858.easyPrerequisites:
Oreskos Sun Guide doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Tidewater Minion is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
4613-4644-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide using Tidewater Minion's ability by tapping it, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-3129-4094-5478-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
1308-3129-4094-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

997-3413-4875.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2919-4050-5086-5183-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4050-5086-5183-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-2079-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-2079-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1477-2092-2757-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Extruder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Extruder, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

772-891-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2366-5702-6968-7288.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5702-6968-7288.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Groundchuck & Dirtbag triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

4396-4871-5220-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4396-4871-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

622-4772-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
622-4772-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Kamahl
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1753-2366-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1753-2366-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

500-4881-6909.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Carnage and creating two token copies of it with reduced power and toughness.
Put either Carnage token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage tokens enter, they trigger, returning up to two applicable cards from your graveyard to the battlefield, including Activated Sleeper if it's in your graveyard.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1796-4046-7070.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Outrider en-Kor.
The Outrider en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Outrider en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1753-2478.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

625-1376-1978.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Elves on the battlefield.
625-1376-1978.description:
Cause Priest of Titania to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Priest of Titania.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-5231-6872.description:
Activate Pentavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Lord Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.

3305-3817-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

104-1874-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1874-5641.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1812-2092-3525-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
1812-2092-3525-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

152-2092-5116.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 4 or greater.
152-2092-5116.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying at most {3}, creating a token copy of Gilded Lotus.
Activate the Gilded Lotus token by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Repeat.
If Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 5 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana and you can then target any other artifact(s) using Cogwork Assembler.

914-3398-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control a number of artifacts and/or enchantments equal to or greater than seven divided by the number of opponents you have, rounded up.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger or Dockside Extortionist.
914-3398-4711.description:
Declare Dockside Extortionist and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering Hellkite Charger and Dockside Extortionist's myriad ability.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least one token copy of Dockside Extortionist that is tapped and attacking.
When the Dockside Extortionist token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger from step 1, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1171-1656-2335-5215.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1171-1656-2335-5215.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, causing you to pay {1}{G} to cast a copy of Regrowth.
Resolve Regrowth, returning Garth One-Eye to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Krosan Archer's ability by paying {G} and discarding Garth One-Eye, giving Necrotic Ooze +0/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1562-3995-4684.description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Horseshoe Crab that is an artifact.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Machine God's Effigy by paying {U}, untapping it.
Mesemeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat from step 2.

803-1909.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
803-1909.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1950-2178-4050-4149.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghoulcaller Gisa.
1 other creature on the battlefield.
1950-2178-4050-4149.description:
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a creature and create at least 1 zombie.
Thornbite Staff allows Ghoulcaller Gisa to untap with her ability.
Sacrifice the zombie to Ghoulcaller Gisa again to create 2 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Sacrifice a zombie to Ghoulcaller Gisa to create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Sacrifice a zombie to Phyrexian Altar to add {B} to your mana pool.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a zombie and create 3 zombies.
Thornbite Staff untaps Ghoulcaller Gisa again.
Sacrifice a zombie to Phyrexian Altar to add {B} to your mana pool.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa's ability to sacrifice a zombie and create 4 zombies.
Repeat.
